title: [silent-socket-loses-mark] A mark held during a silent outage is still lost without a word if the page is reloaded before the desk reconnects

steps: Laptop 1366x768. 1. Player desk. 2. Make the socket silent both ways (no close) and let reconnects fail (blocked) for about 45 s. 3. At 6 s take a Body mark and let the 5 s Undo run out: the box is drawn held. 4. The banner says 'The connection to the table dropped. Reconnecting...'.
